scope: Noah only: 8 same-instant current22 body pairs,1 separately labeled shadow-only pair,222 continuous fixed-step After crops and2 display-only fountain placements. Not a Before video/full QA/Pixel trial.

visual_review.method: Primary-agent direct inspection of all9 native paired PNG regions,2 full fountain PNGs, raw motion crops0/158/195/221 and contact sheets of all222 After samples. Analysis crops are derivatives, not new Unity renders. No real-time playback/Pixel observation claimed.
visual_review.identity: Original atlas is unchanged; no important new damage to face, eyes, clothing, hue, proportions or tail identity observed in this received scope. This is not universal pixel-perfect silhouette equivalence.
visual_review.motion: Walking, stop/settle, blink, small paw/lean reactions and actual Noah speech are visible. Head-facing lead and signed front/back motion are present in metadata. This confirms motion exists, not measured real-time smoothness.
visual_review.grounding_hold: Shadow-only pair changes1221 pixels, proving the new shadow is rendered. At ordinary town scale the ellipse/contact remains hard to read among the stone texture immediately above the name card; visibly stronger grounded presence is still insufficient. No claim that the component is missing.
visual_review.depth_hold: Shading and relative face/body displacement changed, but both still read as a mostly frontal illustration; left/right reversal and forward/away samples do not clearly communicate a body turning in depth. Under the user standard of obvious improvement without explanation, this is not a visual acceptance candidate.
visual_review.greeting: Closed-eye reaction, small head/body lean and raised paw are visible; these alone do not establish dimensionality.
visual_review.existing_ui_constraint: Conversation panel overlaps hat/ears in Before and After; this retained layout is not a newly introduced Noah regression. No frozen UI was modified.
visual_review.sorting: Declared feet-Y sibling order is correct in two placed fountain examples. Noah stands mostly to the side of fountain; direct overlap is small. These are not a continuous route or exhaustive wood/bench/building/flower occlusion proof.
visual_review.other_characters_scope: All9 paired differences outside Noah projected allowed rectangle are0. Momo is visible in the episode; not a separate visual acceptance of all other five characters or all five town areas.
visual_review.remaining_work: Keep only Noah in scope; resolve readable foot contact and clearly spatial face/body/limb turning before whole QA or device handoff. Do not count a repeated successful capture as visual progress.

work_this_turn: Receipt, independent hash/decode/pixel/protocol/frozen-input validation, visual review and record preservation only. No product/runtime/capture/QA script changes, whole test suite, APK build or device/save operations. Record-only updates do not require Pull/rebuild/re-capture.
